title: Pure Solfachord
summary: Pure Solfachord Pendulum control deck featuring musical fairy scales numbered 1 through 8, supported by modern searchers and Link conductors. Setting contrasting odd and even scales grants complete immunity to effect negation, enabling effortless Pendulum swarming and Quick Effect negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Solfachord Primoa searches any Solfachord card from your Deck on summon, and while you control an odd and an even Solfachord card in your Pendulum Zones, your Solfachord card activations and effects cannot be negated.
Solfachord Solfegia Special Summons itself from hand while you have a Solfachord scale set, and can Special Summon another Solfachord monster from your hand, face-up Extra Deck, or GY.
DoSolfachord Cutia searches any Solfachord Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand when Normal or Special Summoned.
Solfachord Happiness reveals a Solfachord Pendulum Monster in your hand to add 2 Solfachord Pendulum Monsters with different Scales from your Deck, or grants an additional Pendulum Summon this turn.
SolSolfachord Gracia adds a Solfachord Spell or Trap card from your Deck to your hand when Normal or Special Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Solfachord Primoa + Solfachord Happiness
steps: Normal Summon Solfachord Primoa and activate its effect to search DoSolfachord Cutia from your Deck.
Activate Solfachord Happiness, revealing DoSolfachord Cutia to search Solfachord Solfegia and DoSolfachord Coolia from your Deck.
Set DoSolfachord Cutia (Scale 8) and DoSolfachord Coolia (Scale 1) into your Pendulum Zones to enable complete effect protection.
Pendulum Summon Solfachord Solfegia and your searched Solfachord monsters from hand and face-up Extra Deck.
Link Summon GranSolfachord Musecia or GranSolfachord Coolia to prepare disruptions for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: GranSolfachord Coolia gains 2700 ATK, negates an opponent's activated monster effect as a Quick Effect by Special Summoning an odd-Scale Solfachord from your Pendulum Zone, and destroys an opponent's card when they activate an effect.
GranSolfachord Musecia swaps a Pendulum Monster in your hand with a face-up Solfachord Pendulum in your Extra Deck, and searches a Solfachord monster with an opposite Scale parity.
DoSolfachord Coolia negates the effects of up to 2 face-up cards on the field, and destroys an opponent's monster that activates its effect on the field while you control a Scale 9 or higher.
TiSolfachord Beautia banishes an opponent's monster or Spell/Trap card when it leaves the field during battle or card effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Solfachord Elegance places Solfachord Pendulum Monsters from your Deck directly into your Pendulum Zones or draws 2 cards.
Solfachord Harmonia Field Spell adds a face-up Solfachord Pendulum from your Extra Deck to hand, modulates Pendulum Scales, and destroys an opponent's card.
Solfachord Formal Counter Trap shuffles a face-up Pendulum from your Extra Deck into the Deck to negate an opponent's Spell, Trap, or monster effect.
Solfachord Symphony destroys an opponent's card and cheats out a GranSolfachord Link Monster directly from your Extra Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Forbidden cards such as Baronne de Fleur and Apollousa, Bow of the Goddess, as well as outside engines like Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon, are omitted in favor of pure Solfachord Link bosses.
